privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Polyglot Language School (Samarkand, Republic of Uzbekistan) collects, uses, stores, and protects personal data when you use our website (the "Site"), submit an enrollment or contact request, or interact with our services. The Policy is drawn up with regard to the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan No. ZRU-709 of 2 July 2019 "On Personal Data" and other applicable legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of your personal data is Polyglot Language School, operating in Samarkand, Republic of Uzbekistan (hereinafter — "we", "us"). For privacy-related requests, you can contact us using the phone numbers on this page or via the contact section of the Site.

sections.title: 2. What data we collect
paragraphs: We may process the following categories of personal data, depending on how you interact with us:
— identification and contact data: full name, phone number, preferred branch or campus, and other information you voluntarily provide in forms (e.g. enrollment, callback, or contact requests);

— technical data when you visit the Site: IP address, browser type, device type, date and time of access, cookies and similar technologies (if we use them), as described in your browser settings and applicable cookie notices.

We do not require special categories of personal data (health, biometric data, etc.) through the Site unless explicitly necessary for a specific service and collected with separate consent where the law requires it.

sections.title: 3. Purposes of processing
paragraphs: We process personal data for the following purposes:
— processing enrollment and trial-lesson requests, contacting you, organizing visits to branches, and concluding or performing an agreement on educational services;
— responding to inquiries, improving the quality of service, and internal administration;
— ensuring the security of the Site, preventing fraud and abuse, and complying with legal obligations of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
We do not use your data for incompatible purposes without an additional legal basis.

sections.title: 4. Legal grounds
paragraphs: Processing is based, as applicable, on: your consent (including by submitting a form with personal data); steps prior to entering into a contract or performance of a contract for educational services; and our legitimate interests that do not override your rights, where permitted by law. Where the law requires separate consent (e.g. certain marketing communications), we will obtain it explicitly.

sections.title: 5. Disclosure and cross-border transfer
paragraphs: We may transfer personal data to processors who assist us in operating the Site and business (e.g. hosting provider, IT services), subject to confidentiality and data-protection requirements.

Enrollment data you submit may be forwarded to our internal messaging systems (for example, Telegram) so that staff can process your application promptly. Such providers may process data on servers located outside the Republic of Uzbekistan. Cross-border transfer of personal data is carried out in accordance with Chapter 7 of the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan "On Personal Data" (including where the recipient country ensures adequate protection or other conditions set by law are met).
We do not sell personal data to third parties.

sections.title: 6. Retention
paragraphs: We store personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes stated in this Policy, unless a longer period is required by law (e.g. accounting or dispute resolution). When data is no longer needed, we delete or anonymize it in line with our internal procedures.

sections.title: 7. Security
paragraphs: We implement organizational and technical measures appropriate to the risks, including restricted access to personal data, secure transmission where possible, and staff confidentiality. No method of transmission over the Internet is completely secure; we encourage you not to send unnecessary sensitive information through open channels.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: Under the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan "On Personal Data", you have the right, subject to statutory conditions, to request information about the processing of your personal data, to access, rectify, or delete data where applicable, to withdraw consent where processing is consent-based, and to object to processing where the law allows.
You may exercise these rights by contacting us using the contacts below. We may need to verify your identity before fulfilling a request.

sections.title: 9. Complaints and supervisory authority
paragraphs: If you believe your rights have been violated, you may file a complaint with the authorized state body for personal data protection in the Republic of Uzbekistan, as determined under current legislation, in addition to contacting us directly.

sections.title: 10. Children
paragraphs: Our services are primarily aimed at students and their legal representatives. If we become aware that we have collected personal data from a child without appropriate authority where required by law, we will take steps to delete such information.

sections.title: 11. Changes
paragraphs: We may update this Policy to reflect legal or operational changes. The current version will always be published on this page with an updated "Last updated" date. We recommend reviewing the Policy periodically.

ofertaPage.title: Public Offer Agreement
ofertaPage.intro: This Public Offer Agreement (hereinafter — the 'Agreement') is an official proposal by the 'Polyglot' language school (hereinafter — the 'Service Provider') to enter into a paid educational services agreement on the terms set out below. This Agreement is drawn up in accordance with Articles 367–370 of the Civil Code of the Republic of Uzbekistan.

sections.title: 1. General Provisions
paragraphs: 1.1. This public offer is addressed to individuals and legal entities and constitutes an official proposal by the Service Provider to enter into an educational services agreement.

1.2. Acceptance of this offer occurs when the Customer performs any of the following actions: payment of an invoice, submission of an application on the website, or verbal or written confirmation of enrollment.
1.3. From the moment of acceptance, this offer has the legal force of a bilateral agreement in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan.

sections.title: 2. Terms and Definitions
paragraphs: 'Service Provider' — the 'Polyglot' language school carrying out educational activities in the Republic of Uzbekistan.
'Customer' — an individual or legal entity who has accepted this offer.
'Student' — the person directly attending classes (may coincide with the Customer).
'Services' — educational services for teaching foreign languages provided in accordance with the Service Provider's curricula.

sections.title: 3. Subject of the Agreement
paragraphs: 3.1. The Service Provider undertakes to provide the Customer with educational services for the selected course (General English, IELTS, TOEFL, Duolingo, CEFR/DTM, English for Kids and others), and the Customer undertakes to accept and pay for these services.
3.2. The specific course, schedule, level, and duration of study are determined upon enrollment based on the results of a diagnostic test.
3.3. Services are provided at the Service Provider's learning centres in Samarkand, Uzbekistan, or remotely where available.

sections.title: 4. Enrollment and Service Delivery
paragraphs: 4.1. To enroll, the Customer submits an application on the website, by phone, or in person at one of the Service Provider's branches.
4.2. The Service Provider conducts a free diagnostic test to determine the Student's language level.
4.3. Based on the test results, the Customer is offered a suitable course and group taking the schedule into account.
4.4. Classes are held according to the approved schedule. The Service Provider notifies the Customer of any postponement or cancellation at least 24 hours in advance.

sections.title: 5. Cost and Payment Procedure
paragraphs: 5.1. The cost of services is determined by the Service Provider's current price list at the time of signing the agreement.
5.2. Payment is made monthly by the 5th day of the current month of study. The Service Provider may accept payment for several months in advance.
5.3. Payment is accepted in cash at the Service Provider's office or by bank transfer to the details specified in Section 12 of this Agreement.
5.4. If payment is overdue by more than 10 business days, the Service Provider may temporarily suspend service delivery until the debt is settled.
5.5. If the Agreement is terminated at the Customer's initiative, a refund for unused classes will be issued in the amount of 80% of the paid amount minus the actual classes held.

sections.title: 6. Rights and Obligations of the Service Provider
paragraphs: 6.1. The Service Provider undertakes to: conduct quality classes in accordance with the curriculum; provide the Student with necessary learning materials; notify the Customer of changes to the schedule and learning conditions.

6.2. The Service Provider is entitled to: make changes to curricula to improve their effectiveness; transfer the Student to another group when there are objective grounds; unilaterally terminate the agreement if the Customer systematically violates the terms of this offer.

sections.title: 7. Rights and Obligations of the Customer
paragraphs: 7.1. The Customer undertakes to: make timely payments for services; ensure that the Student complies with the Service Provider's internal rules; notify the Service Provider of class absences at least 2 hours before they begin.

7.2. The Customer is entitled to: receive information about the Student's learning progress; demand the rectification of identified deficiencies in service quality; terminate the agreement early with written notice to the Service Provider 5 business days in advance.

sections.title: 8. Liability
paragraphs: 8.1. The parties bear responsibility for non-performance or improper performance of their obligations in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
8.2. The Service Provider is not liable for the Student's learning outcomes if the Student systematically misses classes or fails to complete homework.
8.3. The parties are released from liability in the event of force majeure circumstances, which must be notified to the other party within 3 business days.

sections.title: 9. Confidentiality and Personal Data
paragraphs: 9.1. The Customer consents to the processing of their personal data and the Student's personal data for the purposes of fulfilling this agreement.

9.2. The Service Provider undertakes to store personal data in accordance with the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan 'On Personal Data' and not to transfer it to third parties without the Customer's consent.
9.3. The Service Provider may use photographs and videos featuring the Student exclusively for educational and marketing purposes with the Customer's written consent.

sections.title: 10. Amendment and Termination
paragraphs: 10.1. The Service Provider may unilaterally amend the terms of this offer by publishing a new version on the website. Changes take effect 10 calendar days after publication.

10.2. The Agreement may be terminated by mutual consent, at the Customer's initiative (with 5 business days' notice) or at the Service Provider's initiative (with 10 business days' notice and full settlement).

sections.title: 11. Dispute Resolution
paragraphs: 11.1. All disputes and disagreements arising from this agreement shall be resolved through negotiation.
11.2. If a pre-trial resolution is not possible, the dispute shall be submitted to the court at the Service Provider's location in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
11.3. Complaints are reviewed within 15 business days from the date of receipt.
